dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Hmara is at risk due to behavioral reasons. While in care, Hmara has been observed to be highly fearful and kennel reactive, growling and lunging while handlers attempt to leash her. This behavior is not redirectable with high value treats or coaxing. Hmara's reactivity has escalated and in a recent interaction, she lunged and attempted to bite a staff member's hand as they were leashing her. When outside, Hmara has been noted to be tense, flinch at loud sounds, and tremble when pet. She is noted to have no reactivity to any stimuli while outside, walks with no pulling on leash, and allowed a coat to be put on her. With select handlers, Hmara has allowed petting. Medically, Hmara is underweight, and is otherwise is healthy at this time.

Hmara arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, Hmara has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to have a tense body and tucked tail while on leash. Recently Hmara has been observed to growl and lunge at handlers when they approach in an attempt to leash her. This behavior is not easily redirected. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
